usage: Repo with no recent code changes should be archived
name: Repo with no code changes recently should be archived
description: Repositories with no changes in the last few months may be candidates for archival.
detailedDescription: Consider archiving repos that have become redundant or are no longer needed. Archiving a repo removes all write actions from the repo and prevents new issues from being created. Archiving a repo also informs all users with visibility to the repo that it is no longer in use and should not be used in anyway.
